claims.statement: Florentine secretary, present at the Borgia court in autumn 1502 and involved in the Arno project. The documents establish overlap, while any personal friendship is an interpretation.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Florentine correspondence.

flags: The bar shows an overlap in time and place. It does not record a relationship.
